completion_decisions: The target package is the Dirichlet-Multinomial uncertain-wind model, analytical normal-approximation CVaR and fixed-count binary GA on both paper cases; TO and RO are retained objective variants, not unrelated baseline algorithms.
No target-paper code or machine-readable NDAWN archive was located; all 41 station records are executable using a versioned deterministic proxy and are not presented as author data.
Legal retrieval of the customized binary-GA predecessor DOI 10.1109/CCTA41146.2020.9206378 was attempted but yielded no usable full text at the audit date.
The target omits GA budget and operator settings; the implementation isolates a declared population-64, 312-generation, count-preserving completion rather than silently guessing.
Candidate points span the square boundaries inclusively: 2000/11 m and 1550/9 m satisfy the stated 172.172 m safety distance, unlike literal 2000/12 m and 1550/10 m cell widths.
All direction/candidate wake ratios are precomputed and every 64-member generation is evaluated by one persistent full-core team without changing generational semantics.

H6 uses one versus twenty workers for the same full-budget trajectory; the formal campaign uses twenty concurrent one-worker tasks because that is the higher-throughput mapping for the 2520 independent runs.

paper.authors: Wen Yi and Mengxuan Song and Jun Wang
paper.title: Wind farm layout optimization with uncertain wind condition

paper_source_conflicts: The target references a customized binary-GA predecessor but does not repeat its operators or settings.
The target's stated square-cell counts and farm side lengths would violate its minimum-distance statement if interpreted as literal cell widths.
Case-B measurements and target Fig. 7 curves are not supplied numerically.

scope.claim_boundary: academic declared reproduction of the paper equations, all objective variants and all 42 problem records; not author code, NDAWN arrays, exact GA settings, random state or numerical replay

constraints_and_repair.authority: target Section 5.1 and declared coordinate interpretation
constraints_and_repair.resolution: exactly 50 distinct boundary-spanning grid points; grid spacing is at least the stated 172.172 m minimum and therefore needs no repair

decision_variables.resolution: 144 or 100 binary occupancy decisions with exactly 50 occupied points

encoding_and_decoder.resolution: fixed-count sorted candidate-index set equivalent to the target binary occupancy vector

initialization.authority: target fixed-count statement plus declared deterministic completion
initialization.resolution: uniform sampling without replacement of 50 candidate points using counter-keyed random events

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: expected AEP, AEP standard deviation, CVaR and minimum sector power for twenty independent runs of every problem/objective record

objective_and_direction.resolution: maximize expected AEP for TO, beta=0.8 analytical lower-tail CVaR for SO, or minimum sector power for RO

paper_native_cases.resolution: one five-sector simulated Case A and 41 twelve-sector station records for Case B, each with TO, SO and RO

parameters.resolution: V=8 m/s, hub=65 m, rotor radius=43.043 m, wake expansion=0.0707, beta=0.8, 50 turbines; declared GA completion is separately recorded

stopping_and_physical_fes.authority: target omission plus declared reproducible completion
stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: 64 initialized layouts plus 312 complete 64-member generations equals 20032 physical layout evaluations

training_and_inference_lifecycle.resolution: no learned component; Case-B Dirichlet parameters are fitted independently from each station's ten historical proxy years

update_order.authority: target fixed-count customized-GA statement plus declared completion
update_order.resolution: binary tournament, count-preserving crossover, one occupied/unoccupied swap per offspring, full offspring evaluation, then deterministic best-64 parent-plus-offspring survival

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: Jensen wake expansion, exact circle-overlap weighting, RSS multi-wake combination, digitized turbine curve and 8760-hour AEP

wind_and_scenario_sampling.authority: target Sections 3-5, Appendix C and declared Case-B proxy
wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: Case A exact five-sector Dirichlet alpha; Case B fixed-point Dirichlet-Multinomial fit from ten historical yearly WRFVs for each of 41 versioned proxy stations
